STYLE OF CAUSE: Bergeron v. Société de transport de Montréal
CITATION: 2018 QCCS 4231
COURT: Superior Court of Quebec
DOCKET: 500-17-045678-176
DATE: 2018-07-30

[1] The plaintiff commenced this action following a slip-and-fall incident on a bus operated by the defendant.
[2] The defendant admits that the incident occurred but denies that it was negligent in the maintenance of the vehicle.
[3] The applicable standard of care requires the defendant to take reasonable steps to keep its vehicles safe for passengers.
[4] The evidence establishes that the bus floor had been wet for an extended period before the incident without being addressed.
[5] The defendant has not discharged its burden of showing that it took reasonable care in the circumstances.
[6] The plaintiff is entitled to damages for the injuries sustained as a result of the fall.
[7] Judgment is entered in favour of the plaintiff, with costs.
